Hint 1: Consider how bootstrap sampling affects the variance and bias of the models. Think about how using only 30% of the training data for each model might influence the predictions.

Hint 2: Look at the plot carefully. How does the average prediction (dotted line) compare to the true observed values? What does this tell you about the model's performance in terms of bias and variance?
